tool.name: xcms plot chromatogram
tool.description: Plots base peak intensity chromatogram (BPI) and total ion current chromatogram (TIC) from MsExperiment files

param.name: images
param.label: @INPUT_IMAGE_LABEL@
param.help: It contains a xcms4::MsExperiment object from: findChromPeaks, groupChromPeaks or adjustRtime

param.name: sampleMetadata
param.label: Sample metadata file
param.help: Must contain at least one column with the sample id and one column with the sample class

tool.help:
@HELP_AUTHORS@
======================= xcms plot chromatogram =======================
----------- Description -----------
This tool will plot Base Peak Intensity chromatogram (BPI) and Total Ion Current chromatogram (TIC) from xcms 4 MsExperiment objects (RData file).
.. _xcms: https://sneumann.github.io/xcms/index.html
----------------- Workflow position -----------------
**Upstream tools**
=========================== ======================== ============================== Name Output file Format =========================== ======================== ============================== xcms4.readMsExperiment ``*``.raw.RData rdata.msnbase.raw --------------------------- ------------------------ ------------------------------ xcms.findChromPeaks ``*``.xset.RData rdata.xcms.findchrompeaks --------------------------- ------------------------ ------------------------------ xcms.findChromPeaks Merger ``*``.merged.RData rdata.xcms.retcor --------------------------- ------------------------ ------------------------------ xcms.adjustRtime ``*``.adjustRtime.RData rdata.xcms.retcor =========================== ======================== ==============================
\
------------ Output files ------------
HTML files. Download the files to open it outside Galaxy in your web application. Plotly was used to plot chromatogram, to allow zooming and highlighting.
**Total Ion Current (TIC) chromatogram** | Sum of intensity (Y) of all ions detected at each retention time (X)
**Base Peak Intensity Chromatogram (BPI)** | Sum of intensity (Y) of the most intense peaks at each retention time (X)
